svg.aria-label: Context residency. Budgeting is a measurement, and so is uptake.
svg.text: Budgeting is a measurement, and so is uptake.
Fetched when a step needs it
Paged in on demand, never inlined
Emitted at dispatch, before the call
Assembled after every gate has run
Indexed and never cited: paid for, with no recorded use
A citation proves injection, not influence.
Skill files are cited, not inlined: an agent carries the kernel and a one-line index, and fetches a
section when a step needs it. Receipts record what was given at dispatch against what the agent cited,
and the receipt contract states what that cannot show: a citation proves injection, not influence.
Evidence: shipped - PROGRESSIVE_DISCLOSURE and load_skill (master-agentic-orchestrator.ts), receipt.ts;
reduction audited from commit f0e35c1, estimate mode
